title: Benign Overfitting of Two-Layer ReLU Networks in Fixed Dimension through Localized Initialization
abstract: arXiv:2505.11621v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Benign overfitting occurs when a model fits noisy training data exactly and still generalizes well. We establish this behavior for finite-width two-layer networks with the standard ReLU activation, trained by gradient flow in fixed dimension. Our data-independent initialization combines Gaussian weights with neurons initially active only on shrinking spherical caps. For uniform spherical inputs and any fixed bounded conditional response law, training and excess risks vanish in probability uniformly over all sufficiently late times. The parameters also converge, with probability tending to one, to an interpolating limit whose excess risk vanishes in probability. We use one schedule depending only on sample size and dimension. Our proof connects the network to a kernel flow whose limit combines ridge regression with localized spikes that fit the training residuals. We give explicit sample-size, width and training-time bounds.

translated_title: 通过局部化初始化实现固定维度下两层ReLU网络的良性过拟合
translated_abstract: 良性过拟合是指模型能够完全拟合含噪训练数据，同时仍保持良好的泛化能力。我们在固定维度下，针对采用标准ReLU激活函数、通过梯度流训练的有限宽度两层网络确立了这一现象。我们提出的数据无关初始化方法将高斯权重与初始仅在收缩球形帽上激活的神经元相结合。对于均匀球面输入和任意固定的有界条件响应规律，训练风险和超额风险在所有足够晚的时间上均一致地依概率收敛于零。参数也以概率趋于一的方式收敛到一个插值极限，该极限的超额风险依概率趋于零。我们使用仅依赖于样本量和维度的单一调度方案。我们的证明将网络与一个核流联系起来，该核流的极限将岭回归与拟合训练残差的局部化尖峰相结合。我们给出了明确的样本量、宽度和训练时间界限。
tldr: 该论文通过一种结合高斯权重与仅在小球形帽上激活的局部化神经元的初始化方法，首次在固定维度下证明了有限宽度两层ReLU网络经梯度流训练后可实现对含噪数据的良性过拟合，并给出了样本量、宽度与训练时间的明确界限。
